issues.title: Device registry has placeholder entries
issues.description: device-registry.json contains two example entries (iot-001, iot-002). Real device data must be entered after initial discovery and onboarding.
issues.resolution: Run the device-onboard workflow (ask the space agent to run it) for each real device, then remove example entries.

issues.title: MQTT broker host not confirmed
issues.description: space-context.json and config.yaml have a default broker host 192.168.1.10:1883. This must be updated to match the actual Mosquitto broker before mqtt-subscribe/publish and telemetry skills will work.
issues.resolution: Edit .navig/config.yaml and .navig/memory/space-context.json — update mqtt.host/port and confirm anonymous access is disabled.

issues.title: IoT VLAN / subnet not confirmed
issues.description: space-context.json has default iot_subnet 192.168.20.0/24 and iot_vlan 20. These must be updated to match the actual isolated segment before vlan-audit produces accurate results.
issues.resolution: Edit .navig/config.yaml and .navig/memory/space-context.json — set iot_subnet, iot_vlan, gateway; update segmentation.md.
